source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 4 (PDF 74-94), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Stoichiometry) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The Greek word 'stoicheion', from which stoichiometry is derived, means:
(Greek lafz 'stoicheion', jis se stoichiometry bana hai, ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stoicheion ka matlab element (unsur) aur metron ka matlab measure (naap) hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: Stoichiometry is derived from Greek words stoicheion means element and metron means measure

blocks.prompt:
2 Collectively, the word stoichiometry means:
(Majmooi taur par lafz stoichiometry ka matlab kya hai?)

options.text: reactants aur products ki miqdaari naap
reactions mein nikalne wali heat ki naap

blocks.explanation: Stoichiometry ka matlab reactants aur products ki miqdaari (quantitative) naap hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: Collectively, stoichiometry means quantitative measure of reactants and products

blocks.prompt:
3 In stoichiometry, the relationship between the amounts of reactants and products is studied in a:
(Stoichiometry mein reactants aur products ki miqdaar ka taluq kis mein parha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stoichiometry balanced chemical equation mein reactants aur products ki miqdaar ka taluq parhti hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: the relationship between the amounts of reactants and products in a balanced chemical equation is studied

blocks.prompt:
4 A balanced chemical equation has, on both sides of the equation:
(Balanced chemical equation ke dono taraf kya barabar hota hai?)

options.text: har qisam ke atoms ki barabar tadaad

blocks.explanation: Balanced equation mein har qisam ke atoms dono taraf barabar hote hain (4.1); molecules, moles aur volumes mukhtalif ho sakte hain, jaise N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃.

book_ref.quote: The balanced chemical equation has the same number of atoms of each type on both sides of equation

blocks.prompt:
5 Stoichiometric calculations obey the law of conservation of mass and the:
(Stoichiometric calculations law of conservation of mass ke ilawa kis law ki pairwi karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stoichiometric calculations law of conservation of mass aur law of definite proportions (muqarrara tanasub ka qanoon) ki pairwi karti hain (4.1).

book_ref.quote: Stoichiometric calculations obey law of conservation of mass and law of definite proportions

blocks.prompt:
6 In terms of stoichiometry, the law of conservation of mass states that in a balanced equation:
(Stoichiometry ke lihaaz se law of conservation of mass kya kehta hai?)

options.text: reactants ka kul mass = products ka kul mass
reactants ke kul moles = products ke kul moles
reactants ka kul volume = products ka kul volume
har reactant ka mass = har product ka mass

blocks.explanation: Balanced equation mein reactants ka kul mass products ke kul mass ke barabar hota hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: the total mass of reactants is equal to the total mass of products in a balanced equation

blocks.prompt:
7 According to the law of definite proportions, a pure compound always contains the same elements combined in the same ratio by:
(Law of definite proportions ke mutabiq aik khalis compound mein elements hamesha kis lihaaz se aik hi nisbat mein hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Khalis (pure) compound mein elements hamesha mass ke lihaaz se aik hi nisbat (ratio) mein jure hote hain (4.1).

book_ref.quote: a pure compound always contains the same element combined in the same ratio by mass

blocks.prompt:
8 The mole is the amount of a substance which contains as many elementary entities as there are atoms in:
(Mole kisi substance ki woh miqdaar hai jis mein utne elementary entities hon jitne atoms kis mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik mole mein utne hi entities hote hain jitne atoms 0.012 kg (12 g) carbon-12 mein hain (4.1).

book_ref.quote: as many elementary entities as there are atoms in 0.012 kg (12 g) of carbon-12

blocks.prompt:
9 In the definition of the mole, the elementary entities may be:
(Mole ki definition mein elementary entities kya ho sakte hain?)

options.text: atoms, molecules, ions, electrons aur doosre particles

blocks.explanation: Elementary entities atoms, molecules, ions, electrons aur doosre particles ho sakte hain (4.1).

book_ref.quote: The elementary entities may be atoms, molecules, ions, electrons, and other particles

blocks.prompt:
10 The number of entities present in one mole of any substance (rounded value used in calculations) is:
(Kisi bhi substance ke aik mole mein entities ki tadaad (calculations wali rounded qeemat) kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh constant Avogadro's number hai, Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³ (4.1).

book_ref.quote: The number of entities present in one mole of a substance is a constant number

blocks.prompt:
11 Avogadro's number is named after a scientist of which country?
(Avogadro's number kis mulk ke scientist ke naam par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh qeemat Italy ke scientist Amedeo Avogadro (1776-1856) se mansoob hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: This value is attributed to an Italian scientist

blocks.prompt:
12 One mole of NaCl contains 6.02 × 10²³:
(Aik mole NaCl mein 6.02 × 10²³ kya hote hain?)

options.text: atoms of Na and Cl together

blocks.explanation: NaCl ionic hai, is liye is ke mole ko formula units mein gina jata hai: 1 mole NaCl mein 6.02 × 10²³ formula units hote hain (4.1).

book_ref.quote: 1 mole of NaCl contains 6.02 x 10²³ formula units of NaCl

blocks.prompt:
13 Chemists use the mole as the SI unit to:
(Chemists mole ko SI unit ke taur par kis kaam ke liye istemal karte hain?)

options.text: atoms, molecules, formula units ya ions ko tolna aur ginna

blocks.explanation: Mole woh SI unit hai jis se chemists atoms, molecules, formula units ya ions ko tolte aur ginte hain (4.1).

book_ref.quote: The chemists use the mole as the SI unit to weigh and count atoms

blocks.prompt:
14 The mass of one mole of a substance expressed in grams is called its:
(Kisi substance ke aik mole ka mass grams mein kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molar mass (M) kisi substance ke aik mole ka mass grams mein hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: The mass of one mole of a substance expressed in grams is called molar mass

blocks.prompt:
15 The unit of molar mass is:
(Molar mass ki unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molar mass ki unit g/mol (g mol⁻¹) hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: The unit of molar mass is g/mol

blocks.prompt:
16 Using C = 12.0 and Cl = 35.5, the molar mass of CHCl₃ (H = 1.0) is:
(C = 12.0, Cl = 35.5 aur H = 1.0 le kar CHCl₃ ka molar mass kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molar mass atoms ke masses ka majmooa hai: 12.0 + 1.0 + 3 × 35.5 = 119.5 g/mol (4.1).

book_ref.quote: The mass of one mole of CCl₄ can be found by adding the masses of carbon and chlorine present

blocks.prompt:
17 The mass of one mole of CaO formula units is:
(CaO ke aik mole formula units ka mass kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 mole CaO formula units 56.1 g hai; 44.0 g CO₂ aur 60.0 g CO₃²⁻ ka hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: 1 mole of CaO formula units is 56.1 g

blocks.prompt:
18 The mass of one mole of CO₃²⁻ ions is:
(CO₃²⁻ ions ke aik mole ka mass kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: 1 mole of CO₃²⁻ ions is 60.0 g

blocks.prompt:
19 The number of moles of a substance is calculated by:
(Kisi substance ke moles kaise nikale jaate hain?)

options.text: mass ko molar mass se zarb de kar
molar mass ko mass se taqseem kar ke
mass ko Avogadro's number se zarb de kar
grams mein mass ko molar mass se taqseem kar ke

blocks.explanation: n = m/M: grams mein mass ko molar mass se taqseem karein (4.1).

book_ref.quote: The number of moles of a substance can be calculated by dividing mass in grams by molar mass

blocks.prompt:
20 The number of moles in 10 g of NaOH (molar mass 40 g mol⁻¹) is:
(10 g NaOH (molar mass 40 g mol⁻¹) mein kitne moles hain?)

book_ref.quote: Calculate the number of moles present in 20 g of NaOH

blocks.prompt:
21 The mass of 0.25 mol of HCl (molar mass 36.5 g mol⁻¹) is:
(0.25 mol HCl (molar mass 36.5 g mol⁻¹) ka mass kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mass = n × M = 0.25 × 36.5 = 9.125 g ≈ 9.13 g; jawab grams mein hai (4.1).

book_ref.quote: Mass of HCl = Number of moles x Molar mass

blocks.prompt:
22 The mass of 2 × 10⁻³ mol of MgSO₄ (molar mass 120 g mol⁻¹) is:
(2 × 10⁻³ mol MgSO₄ (molar mass 120 g mol⁻¹) ka mass kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Molar mass of MgSO₄ = 24 + 96 = 120 g mol⁻¹

blocks.text: 4.2 Relationship between mole, molar mass and Avogadro's number

blocks.prompt:
23 12.0 g of carbon contains the same number of atoms as:
(12.0 g carbon mein utne hi atoms hain jitne kis mein?)
blocks.explanation: 12.0 g carbon aur 4.0 g helium dono 1 mole atoms hain, yani 6.02 × 10²³ (4.2).

book_ref.quote: A sample of 12.0 grams of natural carbon contains the same number of atoms as 4.0 grams of natural helium

blocks.prompt:
24 To have equal numbers of atoms, sodium must be taken in a mass greater than that of hydrogen by a factor of:
(Barabar atoms lene ke liye sodium ka mass hydrogen se kitne guna zyada lena hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium ka atom hydrogen ke atom se 23 guna bhari hai, is liye 23 guna mass lene se atoms barabar hon ge (4.2).

book_ref.quote: An atom of sodium is 23 times heavier than an atom of hydrogen

blocks.prompt:
25 One mole of water (18.0 g) and one mole of glucose (180.0 g) have:
(Aik mole paani (18.0 g) aur aik mole glucose (180.0 g) mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: mass barabar aur molecules bhi barabar
mass bhi mukhtalif aur molecules bhi mukhtalif
mass mukhtalif magar molecules ki tadaad barabar

blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif compounds ke aik mole ke mass mukhtalif hote hain magar molecules ki tadaad barabar, 6.02 × 10²³ (4.2).

book_ref.quote: one mole of different compounds has different masses but the same number of molecules

blocks.prompt:
26 96.1 g of SO₄²⁻ and 62.0 g of NO₃⁻ each contain:
(96.1 g SO₄²⁻ aur 62.0 g NO₃⁻ mein se har aik mein kitne ions hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har aik 1 mole ions hai; kisi bhi ionic species ke aik mole mein ions Avogadro's number hote hain (4.2).

book_ref.quote: the number of ions in one mole of different ionic species is always the same

blocks.prompt:
27 The number of moles in 1.204 × 10²⁴ molecules of a substance is:
(Kisi substance ke 1.204 × 10²⁴ molecules mein kitne moles hain?)
blocks.explanation: Moles = particles / Nₐ = 1.204 × 10²⁴ / 6.02 × 10²³ = 2.00 mol (4.2).

book_ref.quote: One can calculate the number of moles by dividing the number of particles by Avogadro

blocks.prompt:
28 The number of atoms in 4.6 g of sodium (molar mass 23.0 g mol⁻¹) is:
(4.6 g sodium (molar mass 23.0 g mol⁻¹) mein kitne atoms hain?)

book_ref.quote: Number of atoms of sodium = Number of moles of sodium x Nₐ

blocks.prompt:
29 The number of molecules in 9.0 g of water (molar mass 18.0 g mol⁻¹) is:
(9.0 g paani (molar mass 18.0 g mol⁻¹) mein kitne molecules hain?)

book_ref.quote: The relationship between amounts of substances in terms of their moles and the number of particles

blocks.prompt:
30 In the scheme linking mass, moles and particles, moles are changed into number of particles by:
(Mass, moles aur particles wali scheme mein moles ko particles ki tadaad mein kaise badla jata hai?)

options.text: Avogadro's number se zarb de kar
Avogadro's number se taqseem kar ke
molar mass se zarb de kar
molar mass se taqseem kar ke

blocks.explanation: Particles ki tadaad = moles × Nₐ; mass = moles × molar mass (4.2).

book_ref.quote: Mass in grams, moles and number of particles

blocks.prompt:
31 Juglone has the formula C₁₀H₆O₃. Using C = 12.0, H = 1.0 and O = 16.0, the number of moles in 1.74 g of juglone is:
(Juglone ka formula C₁₀H₆O₃ hai. C = 12.0, H = 1.0, O = 16.0 le kar 1.74 g juglone mein kitne moles hain?)

book_ref.quote: The formula for juglone is C₁₀H₆O₃

blocks.prompt:
32 Juglone, obtained from the husks of black walnuts, acts as a natural:
(Black walnut ke chhilkon se milne wala juglone qudrati taur par kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Juglone qudrati herbicide (jaree booti maarne wala) hai; yeh black walnut ke ird gird muqabil podon ko maar deta hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: Juglone, is a natural herbicide (weed killer)

blocks.prompt:
33 The molar mass of isopentyl acetate, C₇H₁₄O₂ (C = 12.0, H = 1.0, O = 16.0), is:
(Isopentyl acetate, C₇H₁₄O₂ (C = 12.0, H = 1.0, O = 16.0) ka molar mass kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Isopentyl acetate (C₇H₁₄O₂) is the compound responsible for the scent of bananas

blocks.prompt:
34 Isopentyl acetate, released by bees when they sting, is the compound responsible for the scent of:
(Shehad ki makkhi dank marte waqt jo isopentyl acetate chhorti hai, woh kis ki khushboo ka zimmedar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Isopentyl acetate kelon (bananas) ki khushboo deta hai; dank marti makkhi ka chhora hua taqreeban 1 μg doosri makkhiyon ko bulata hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: The resulting scent attracts other bees to join the attack

blocks.prompt:
35 The volume of one mole of an ideal gas at STP is called:
(STP par aik mole ideal gas ka volume kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molar volume STP par aik mole ideal gas ka volume hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: The volume of one mole of an ideal gas at STP (Standard temperature and pressure) is called molar volume

blocks.prompt:
36 The commonly used (rounded) value of molar volume at STP is:
(STP par molar volume ki aam rounded qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molar volume 22.414 dm³ hai jise aam taur par 22.4 dm³ liya jata hai; is ki alamat Vₘ hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: The value of molar volume is commonly rounded to 22.4 dm³

blocks.prompt:
37 The molar volume relationship is used to convert the mass or moles of a gas at STP into its:
(Molar volume ke taluq se STP par gas ke mass ya moles ko kis mein badla jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molar volume se STP par gas ka mass ya mole volume mein, aur volume wapas mole mein badla ja sakta hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: mass or mole of a gas at STP can be converted into volume, and vice versa

blocks.prompt:
38 'Equal volumes of all ideal gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules.' This is:
('Same temperature aur pressure par tamam ideal gases ke barabar volumes mein barabar molecules hote hain.' Yeh kya hai?)

options.text: the law of conservation of mass

blocks.explanation: Yeh Avogadro's law ka bayan hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: Equal volumes of all ideal gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules

blocks.prompt:
39 At STP, 22.4 dm³ of NH₃ gas has a mass of:
(STP par 22.4 dm³ NH₃ gas ka mass kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: STP par 22.4 dm³ har gas 1 mole hai, yani us ka molar mass grams mein; NH₃ ke liye 17 g (4.3).

book_ref.quote: 22.4 dm³ of NH₃ gas at STP = 17 g

blocks.prompt:
40 At STP, 22.4 dm³ of H₂ and 22.4 dm³ of CO₂ contain:
(STP par 22.4 dm³ H₂ aur 22.4 dm³ CO₂ mein kya barabar hai?)

options.text: oxygen ke atoms ki barabar tadaad

blocks.explanation: Dono 1 mole hain, is liye dono mein 6.02 × 10²³ molecules hain; un ke mass (2 g aur 44.0 g) mukhtalif hain (4.3).

book_ref.quote: 22.4 dm³ of any gas at STP = molar mass in grams

blocks.prompt:
41 The volume of 1.5 mol of oxygen gas at STP is:
(STP par 1.5 mol oxygen gas ka volume kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: calculate the volume of a gas by multiplying number of moles of the gas by molar volume

blocks.prompt:
42 The number of moles in 11.2 dm³ of a gas at STP is:
(STP par 11.2 dm³ gas mein kitne moles hain?)

book_ref.quote: 22.4 dm³ of a gas at STP = Molar mass of a gas

blocks.prompt:
43 The volume of 8.5 g of NH₃ (molar mass 17 g mol⁻¹) at STP is:
(STP par 8.5 g NH₃ (molar mass 17 g mol⁻¹) ka volume kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: 22.4 dm³ of H₂ gas at STP = 2 g

blocks.text: 4.4 Molar mass and density of gases

blocks.prompt:
44 Density is defined as:
(Density ki definition kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Density = mass / volume, d = m/V (4.4).

book_ref.quote: Density is defined as the mass per unit volume of a substance

blocks.prompt:
45 At STP, which gas has the highest density? (Molar masses: H₂ = 2, NH₃ = 17, N₂ = 28, CO₂ = 44 g mol⁻¹)
(STP par kis gas ki density sab se zyada hai? (Molar masses: H₂ = 2, NH₃ = 17, N₂ = 28, CO₂ = 44 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: STP par sab gases ka molar volume barabar hai, is liye zyada molar mass wali gas ki density zyada: CO₂ (4.4).

book_ref.quote: A gas having higher molar mass will have higher density and vice versa

blocks.prompt:
46 A gas has a density of 1.25 g dm⁻³ at STP. Its molar mass is:
(Aik gas ki STP par density 1.25 g dm⁻³ hai. Is ka molar mass kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molar mass = d × Vₘ = 1.25 × 22.4 = 28.0 g mol⁻¹ (4.4).

book_ref.quote: If the density of gas at STP is determined, its molar mass can be calculated

blocks.prompt:
47 The density of methane, CH₄ (molar mass 16.0 g mol⁻¹), at STP is about:
(STP par methane, CH₄ (molar mass 16.0 g mol⁻¹) ki density taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: As molar mass of all the gases occupies same volume at STP

blocks.prompt:
48 Molar concentration is the number of moles of a substance dissolved per:
(Molar concentration kisi substance ke kitne moles fi kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Molar concentration (mol/dm³) fi dm³ solution mein hal shuda moles hain (4.5).

book_ref.quote: the number of moles of a substance (reactant or product) dissolved per volume of a solution in dm³

blocks.prompt:
49 In the relation n = C × V, the symbol V stands for the volume of the:
(n = C × V mein V kis ka volume hai?)
blocks.explanation: C molar concentration aur V solution ka volume hai (4.5).

book_ref.quote: where C is the molar concentration and V is the volume of the solution

blocks.prompt:
50 5.85 g of NaCl (molar mass 58.5 g mol⁻¹) is dissolved to make 0.5 dm³ of solution. The molar concentration is:
(5.85 g NaCl (molar mass 58.5 g mol⁻¹) hal kar ke 0.5 dm³ solution banaya gaya. Molar concentration kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The relationship between number of moles and molar concentration is given by

blocks.prompt:
51 The number of moles of solute in 0.25 dm³ of a 0.4 mol dm⁻³ solution is:
(0.4 mol dm⁻³ solution ke 0.25 dm³ mein solute ke kitne moles hain?)

book_ref.quote: Molar concentration of solutions is given as mol/dm³

blocks.prompt:
52 13.82 g of K₂CO₃ (molar mass 138.2 g mol⁻¹) is dissolved to make 2 dm³ of solution. The molar concentration is:
(13.82 g K₂CO₃ (molar mass 138.2 g mol⁻¹) hal kar ke 2 dm³ solution banaya gaya. Molar concentration kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Molar mass of K₂CO₃ = 138.2 g mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
53 The number of moles of a gas at STP can be found from its volume by:
(STP par gas ke moles us ke volume se kaise nikalte hain?)

options.text: Avogadro's number se taqseem kar ke
molar mass se zarb de kar

blocks.explanation: Moles ke concept map mein n = V / Vₘ, yani STP volume ko 22.4 dm³ se taqseem karein (4.3, 4.5).

book_ref.quote: Number of moles concept map

blocks.prompt:
54 The branch of chemistry which tells the quantitative relationship between reactants and products in a balanced equation is:
(Chemistry ki woh shaakh jo balanced equation mein reactants aur products ka miqdaari taluq batati hai:)
blocks.explanation: Yeh stoichiometry ki definition hai (4.6).

book_ref.quote: Stoichiometry is a branch of chemistry which tells us the quantitative relationship between reactants and products

blocks.prompt:
55 Which of the following is NOT one of the quantities used to set up stoichiometric relationships?
(In mein se kaun si quantity stoichiometric taluqaat banane mein istemal hone walon mein se NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mole, Avogadro's number, molar mass, molar volume aur molar concentration balanced equations ke saath istemal hote hain; melting point nahi (4.6).

book_ref.quote: With the knowledge of mole, Avogadro’s number, molar mass, molar volume, and molar concentration

blocks.prompt:
56 Which of the following is NOT one of the stoichiometric relationships studied with a balanced equation?
(In mein se kaun sa balanced equation se parha jane wala stoichiometric taluq NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhe taluqaat: mole-mole, mass-mass, volume-volume, mole-mass, mole-volume aur mass-volume (4.6).

book_ref.quote: The following types of relationship can be studied with the help of a balanced chemical equation

blocks.prompt:
57 In N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g), one molecule of N₂ reacts with:
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) mein N₂ ka aik molecule kis ke saath react karta hai?)

options.text: H₂ ke 1 molecule se, NH₃ ke 2 molecules
H₂ ke 3 molecules se, NH₃ ke 2 molecules banate hain
H₂ ke 3 molecules se, NH₃ ke 4 molecules
H₂ ke 6 molecules se, NH₃ ke 2 molecules

blocks.explanation: Coefficients 1 : 3 : 2 molecules aur moles dono ki nisbat dete hain (4.6).

book_ref.quote: 1 molecule of N₂ reacts with 3 molecules of H₂ to form 2 molecules of NH₃

blocks.prompt:
58 In N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) at STP, 22.4 dm³ of N₂ reacts with 67.2 dm³ of H₂ to form NH₃ of volume:
(STP par N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) mein 22.4 dm³ N₂, 67.2 dm³ H₂ se react kar ke kitna NH₃ banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2 mol NH₃ = 2 × 22.4 = 44.8 dm³ STP par (4.6).

book_ref.quote: 22.4 dm³ of N₂ reacts with 67.2 dm³ of H₂ to form 44.8 dm³ of NH₃

blocks.prompt:
59 In N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃, 28.0 g of N₂ reacts with 6 g of H₂. The mass of NH₃ formed is:
(N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃ mein 28.0 g N₂, 6 g H₂ se react karti hai. Kitna NH₃ banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mass mehfooz rehta hai: 28.0 + 6 = 34.0 g NH₃ (2 × 17.0 g) (4.6).

book_ref.quote: 28.0 g of N₂ react with 6 g of H₂ to form 34.0 g of NH₃

blocks.prompt:
60 Which is one of the assumptions made while performing stoichiometric calculations?
(Stoichiometric calculations karte waqt kaun sa mafrooza (assumption) liya jata hai?)

options.text: Kuch reactant hamesha bach jata hai
Koi side reaction (zimni tamul) nahi hota

blocks.explanation: Mafroozaat: tamam reactants poori tarah products ban jaate hain; conservation of mass aur definite proportions ke qawaneen maane jaate hain; koi side reaction nahi hota (4.6).

book_ref.quote: All the reactants are completely converted into the products

blocks.prompt:
61 In N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g), the number of moles of H₂ consumed by 2.5 mol of N₂ is:
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) mein 2.5 mol N₂ kitne moles H₂ istemal karegi?)
blocks.explanation: Mole ratio N₂ : H₂ = 1 : 3, is liye H₂ = 3 × 2.5 = 7.5 mol (4.6).

book_ref.quote: When 3.3 mole of nitrogen reacts with hydrogen to form ammonia

blocks.prompt:
62 In N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g), the number of moles of NH₃ formed from 2.5 mol of N₂ (H₂ in excess) is:
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) mein 2.5 mol N₂ se (H₂ zyada maujood) kitne moles NH₃ banenge?)
blocks.explanation: Mole ratio N₂ : NH₃ = 1 : 2, is liye NH₃ = 2 × 2.5 = 5.0 mol (4.6).

book_ref.quote: Number of moles of N₂ = 3.3 mol

blocks.prompt:
63 For 2Al(s) + Fe₂O₃(s) → Al₂O₃(s) + 2Fe(s), the mass of Al (27 g mol⁻¹) needed to react with 16.0 g of Fe₂O₃ (159.6 g mol⁻¹) is about:
